findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler[QuerySubscriptionUpdate] with just `pass`, but StatefulDetectorHandler declares several abstract members that are not implemented here: `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly-added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. Because none of these are overridden, MetricAlertDetectorHandler remains an abstract class (ABCMeta keeps it in `__abstractmethods__`), so calling `MetricAlertDetectorHandler(detector)` (e.g. via `Detector.detector_handler` -> `group_type.detector_handler(self)`) will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods ...`. Previously this class directly implemented `evaluate` and was a valid concrete class; the refactor silently turned it into a non-functional stub that will crash any code path that tries to use a Detector of type `metric_alert_fire` (including `process_detectors`, which does not guard against an exception here, only against `None`).

findings.title: Stale docstring says evaluate returns a list
findings.body: The docstring for `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` still reads "Evaluates a given data packet and returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`", but this PR changed the return type to `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]`. The docstring was not updated to reflect the new dict-based contract, which is misleading for future readers/implementers of this hook.

findings.title: No test coverage exercising MetricAlertDetectorHandler / detector_handler instantiation for example group types
findings.body: The test suite was rewritten extensively to cover StatefulDetectorHandler behavior through a local MockDetectorStateHandler, but there is no test that instantiates or evaluates MetricAlertDetectorHandler (the real example subclass changed in src/sentry/incidents/grouptype.py in this same PR). Because of that, the fact that MetricAlertDetectorHandler is left abstract (missing required overrides) and will raise TypeError on instantiation was not caught by any test in this PR.
